Name: Demo page revamp
Overview text: Audited Atlas Systems' demo page after noticing a dip in signups. Found that the page wasn't tailored to specific ICPs, both products and all services were funnelled through one centralized page with too many form fields. Redesigned it into separate demo pages for each product and service, reduced form friction, ran A/B tests. Weekly demo signups went from 1-2 to 6-8.
